title: CRT matrix coordinate sublemma
statement: For a monic polynomial factorization modulo an ideal, (1) the degree index sets admit an equivalence, and (2) for any such equivalence there is a CRT conjugating unit giving the block matrix identity.

proof.text: Put R = A/I and p = f.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I). Coprimality of g and h implies coprimality of their principal ideals by Ideal.isCoprime_span_singleton_iff. The factorization and Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton identify (p) with (g)(h). Compose Ideal.quotEquivOfEq with Ideal.quotientMulEquivQuotientProd to obtain the CRT ring equivalence. Its formula on polynomial classes shows that it preserves scalars and takes the root of p to the pair of roots, so AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv promotes it to an R-algebra equivalence e.

The private proved helper root_matrix_entry expresses the (i,j) root-multiplication matrix entry as the coefficient at i of X^(j+1) modulo the monic polynomial. It follows from Algebra.leftMulMatrix_eq_repr_mul, the power-basis formula, and AdjoinRoot.modByMonicHom_mk. Polynomial.map_modByMonic and coeff_map show that reducing the root matrix of f gives the root matrix of p. Monicity preserves natDegree, and reindexing the power basis with finCongr followed by the given d gives precisely Matrix.reindex d d of the reduced matrix.

Let b be this reindexed power basis of AdjoinRoot p, and bprime the product of the power bases of the two factor quotients. Define U.val as LinearMap.toMatrix b bprime e.toLinearMap and U.inv as LinearMap.toMatrix bprime b e.symm.toLinearMap. LinearMap.toMatrix_comp and the inverse identities of e prove both unit laws. Because e preserves multiplication and sends the root to the pair of roots, conjugating root multiplication by e gives the product of the two root-multiplication endomorphisms. Apply LinearMap.toMatrix_comp twice and LinearMap.toMatrix_prodMap to obtain the desired block conjugation identity. Empty power bases, including constant factors equal to one, are covered without any extra nontriviality assumption.

lean.statement: theorem adjoinRoot_crt_matrix_for_degree_equiv {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [Nontrivial (A ⧸ I)] (f : A[X]) (hf : f.Monic) (g h : (A ⧸ I)[X]) (hg : g.Monic) (hh : h.Monic) (hcoprime : IsCoprime g h) (hfactor : f.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = g * h) (d : Fin f.natDegree ≃ (Fin g.natDegree ⊕ Fin h.natDegree)) : ∃ (U : (Matrix (Fin g.natDegree ⊕ Fin h.natDegree) (Fin g.natDegree ⊕ Fin h.natDegree) (A ⧸ I))ˣ), U.val * Matrix.reindex d d ((Algebra.leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hf).basis (AdjoinRoot.root f)).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) * U⁻¹.val = Matrix.fromBlocks (Algebra.leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hg).basis (AdjoinRoot.root g)) 0 0 (Algebra.leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hh).basis (AdjoinRoot.root h))
